<!-- pr-reviewer: 680cd215ee26a1fe4bce74a4341212600a9941de -->
Needs changes before merge.

The review used the current upstream `AGENTS.md`. The local trial merge with `upstream/main` at `98f093fba91aea1b63cdd1498722ca9f7d73f428` had no conflicts.

The five Haas definitions match the values in #1976. The decision record states the Mini Mill configuration assumptions. The machine mode uses the existing undoable command. No NC, CL, or snapshot goldens changed.

Local results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| App and UI test build (`--no-run`) | FAIL: UI error E0004 |
| `haas_machines` | PASS: 3 tests |
| `machine` | PASS: 33 tests |
| `machine_library` | PASS: 11 tests |
| `posting` | PASS: 17 tests |
| `sinker_burn` | PASS: 15 tests |
| UI library tests from `crates/ui` | Blocked: UI error E0004 |
| App all-target clippy with `-D warnings` | PASS |
| App and UI all-target clippy with `-D warnings` | FAIL: UI error E0004 |
| Haas post with `full_circle.cnc`, for all five machines | PASS: no warnings and no swallowed blocks |

The build and clippy report:

```text
error[E0004]: non-exhaustive patterns: `camcraft_app::machine::Kind::Waterjet` not covered
  --> crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs:43:11
```

This is a safety-tier review because the definitions set machine limits used for posting. Two independent mutation checks ran locally:

- Remove the VF-2 registry entry: all three Haas tests fail. Restore the exact file: all three pass.
- Raise the VF-2 spindle limit from 8100 to 8101 rpm: the configuration and limit tests fail. Restore the exact file: all three pass.

Both files match the trial merge after restoration. No mutation was committed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs:43`: Cover `Kind::Waterjet` in `short_caption`. Current upstream main adds this kind. The trial merge cannot compile without that case. Run the UI tests and all-target clippy again after the fix.
2. `crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs:28`: Add before/after screenshots to this PR body for the inherited Sinker EDM mode change. The body has no screenshot links. The parent PR has images, but this PR must include the required evidence. Store new screenshots only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.

No GitHub runner was used. The UI integration tests could not run because the UI crate does not compile. Physical machine acceptance and release-only tests were not performed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Covered `Kind::Waterjet` in `short_caption`. It keeps upstream's generic `Machine` caption. The pin `waterjet_without_a_mode_keeps_the_generic_door_caption` also mounts Waterjet and checks the ribbon text. Removing the arm reproduces E0004. Changing its caption fails the pin. Restoring the fix passes. Upstream main was merged cleanly.
2. Added before/after Sinker EDM ribbon screenshots to this PR body at 1280 and 1920 px. They are exact copies of the parent PR's renders, stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The body link check fails without the section and passes with it. All four published PNGs match the original blobs.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 193 app binaries, 908 UI library tests (6 ignored), and 30 UI integration tests. App and UI all-target clippy passed with `-D warnings`.

New head: `d2455e145cd2e1f6c9c0ebca511a334591b97e93`.

Please re-review. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d2455e145cd2e1f6c9c0ebca511a334591b97e93 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge, after parent PR #1753.

This review used the current upstream `AGENTS.md` (PROCESS_VERSION 77). The local trial merge used `upstream/main` at `98f093fba91aea1b63cdd1498722ca9f7d73f428`. That commit is already in this head. The merge has no conflicts.

The two earlier findings are resolved:

- `short_caption` covers `Kind::Waterjet`. The app and UI test build now passes. The UI test checks the generic `Machine` caption.
- The PR body has before/after screenshot links at 1280 and 1920 px. All four images load. They show the added Sinker EDM tab. The images are outside the PR branch.

The five Haas definitions match the values requested in #1976. The decision record states the Mini Mill configuration assumptions. The Sinker EDM mode uses the existing undoable command. The empty sinker template refuses posting until the required codes are set. No NC, CL, or snapshot goldens changed.

Local results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| App and UI test build (`--no-run`) | PASS |
| `haas_machines` | PASS: 3 tests |
| `machine` | PASS: 33 tests |
| `machine_library` | PASS: 11 tests |
| `posting` | PASS: 17 tests |
| `sinker_burn` | PASS: 15 tests |
| UI library, from `crates/ui` | PASS: 908 tests; 6 ignored |
| UI `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool` | PASS: 30 tests |
| App and UI all-target clippy with `-D warnings` | PASS |
| Standalone Haas post with `full_circle.cnc`, all five machines | PASS: no warnings; zero swallowed blocks |

This is a safety-tier review. The machine definitions set limits used for posting. Two mutation checks ran locally:

1. Remove the VF-2 registry entry: all three Haas tests fail. Restore the exact file: all three pass.
2. Raise the VF-2 spindle limit from 8100 to 8101 rpm: the configuration and limit tests fail. Restore the exact file: all three pass.

No mutation was committed. The worktree matches the reviewed head after restoration.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: Existing large files grew in `posting.rs`, `machine.rs`, and `sinker_burn.rs`. A later change can split these files by function. The stated DT-1 and DM-1 tapping ceiling remains outside the current schema. The decision record and PR body disclose this limit. Physical machine acceptance and release-only tests did not run. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed the latest review:

- Corrected Mini Mill spindle power from 7.5 kW to 5.6 kW. The source states 7.5 hp. The decision record cites Haas CNC Guide, Issue 18, page 10.
- Updated `every_haas_machine_states_its_requested_configuration` to check 5.6 kW. Restoring 7.5 kW fails the test. Restoring 5.6 kW passes.
- Merged upstream main to resolve the caption conflict. Kept main's `Waterjet` caption. Updated `waterjet_without_a_mode_keeps_the_specific_door_caption`. Restoring `Machine` fails the test. Restoring `Waterjet` passes. The conflict contained no safety guard or refusal.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed against the merged main at `ef1f53451`. It ran 187 app binaries. UI tests passed: 915 library tests and 30 integration tests. Six tests were ignored.
App and UI all-target clippy passed with `-D warnings`.

New head: `441c86a88fa7fc2b6ceb79bc3c66e7e0cdffd7e9`.

The PR is a draft for this review fix. No labels were removed. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed.
Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 441c86a88fa7fc2b6ceb79bc3c66e7e0cdffd7e9 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This review used current upstream `AGENTS.md`, PROCESS_VERSION 79, and the machine and UI rules from upstream main. The local trial merge with `upstream/main` at `4b7a6b1e87d3db22222ea3132f95a45f20a45f8a` had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

The earlier findings are resolved:

- The Mini Mill definition and test state 5.6 kW. The decision record cites the source and explains the conversion.
- The Waterjet test expects upstream's specific `Waterjet` door caption. It passes in the merged UI suite.
- The body has before/after screenshots at 1280 and 1920 px. All four PNGs load. The inspected pair shows the Sinker EDM tab. The images are outside the PR branch.

The five original JSON definitions match the requested travel, feed, rapid, spindle, holder and changer configurations, with the stated power correction. The Mini Mill options and rate assumptions are recorded. No post script, dependency, process file, NC golden, CL golden or snapshot PNG changed.

Local results on the trial merge:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| App test build for the four selected suites | PASS |
| `haas_machines` | PASS: 3 tests |
| `machine` | PASS: 33 tests |
| `machine_library` | PASS: 11 tests |
| `posting` | PASS: 17 tests |
| UI library build | PASS |
| UI library, six test threads, from `crates/ui` | 932 passed; 1 failed; 6 ignored |
| App and UI all-target clippy, `-D warnings` | PASS |
| Haas CLI, `full_circle.cnc`, all five machines | PASS: no warnings; zero swallowed blocks |

The UI suite is not green. Its remaining failure also occurs on unmodified upstream main at the same SHA:

```text
crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/stock_fit.rs:31:7
stock_fit_controls_follow_the_selected_shape
Found two or more nodes matching the query:
By {
    label: "Delete",
}
```

The upstream UI run had 931 passed, 1 failed and 6 ignored. The same test also failed alone on both trees. This is an existing main failure, not a requested PR change.

The first merged run used the default thread count. It had 931 passed, 2 failed and 6 ignored. Its additional failure was `setup_picks_disarm::a_click_in_the_frame_the_pane_hides_misses_the_hidden_draft` at line 304. The assertion reported `left: 0`, `right: 1`. That test passed alone and in the six-thread rerun. It also passed in the upstream suite.

This is a safety-tier review because the definitions set limits used for posting. Two independent mutations ran locally:

1. Remove VF-2 from the registry: all three Haas tests fail. Restore the exact file: all three pass.
2. Raise the VF-2 spindle limit from 8100 to 8101 rpm: the configuration and limit tests fail. Restore the exact file: all three pass.

Both mutated files were restored. No mutation was committed. No moved goldens required a line review.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes, not blocking:

- The [Haas CNC Guide, Issue 18](https://haas.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Haas-CNC-Guide-Issue-18.pdf), printed page 10, states 7.5 hp for the Mini Mill. This supports about 5.6 kW. The [Mini Mill product page](https://legacy-aem.haascnc.com/machines/vertical-mills/mini-mills/models/minimill.html) instead states 10 hp and 7.5 kW. The sources disagree. The correction follows the source requested in the earlier review; it does not establish that every 7.5 kW specification is a unit error.
- The DT-1 and DM-1 tapping ceiling remains outside the current schema. The body and decision record disclose this limit.
- The complete quick gate, physical machine acceptance and release-only tests did not run. The review ran the selected machine and posting suites, UI library, clippy and CLI checks listed above.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
